mechanism: Both phenobarbital and St. John's Wort are potent CYP450 enzyme inducers that increase metabolism of numerous drugs, and combined use significantly increases induction of CYP3A4, CYP2C9, CYP2C19, and other enzymes, reducing effectiveness of many medications including oral contraceptives, warfarin, and other substrates.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if combination necessary, monitor efficacy of CYP450 substrate medications closely and adjust doses; counsel on increased risk of contraceptive failure and reduced anticoagulation effect.
